# Exact versions of the tools CI installs beside DELFIN, used as
# `pip install -c .github/ci/constraints-ci.txt <tool>`.
#
# Scope: the installer itself (pip), the test runner for the jobs that
# install DELFIN with --no-deps (container, toolchains, macOS sandbox), the
# linter, the audit tool and the build frontend. NOT DELFIN's own
# dependencies: those are ranges in pyproject.toml, held at both ends by the
# py3.11 job (numpy<2) and the reference-environment job
# (env/reference-environment.lock), and constraining them here would make
# the fast suite test this file instead of what users install.
#
# Each set is the full closure pip resolved for it on Python 3.11 on
# 2026-10-15 (`pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --report`); a
# constraint names a version only, so a package listed here and not named on
# the command line is not installed by it.
#
# Raising a version is an ordinary pull request: change the line, and the
# jobs that install it are the test.

pip==26.2.1

# pytest for the --no-deps jobs, and pyyaml for the toolchains job

# lint (a required check: a new ruff release must not change its verdict)
